entries.label: coach_teacher_language_first_00
entries.text: My dear Blueberry friends! Thanks for le warm\naccueil! What a warm welcome![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_first_01
entries.text: Je m’appelle Salvatore. My name is Salvatore!\nI hope we will become fast friends![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp01_00
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Waouh! [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! I am undone by
this
coincidence!
Who
would
have
thought
we
might
meet here?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp01_01
entries.text: It appears that you are doing plutôt bien—quite\nwell, that is—flourishing in the Unova region![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp01_02
entries.text:
Even if they speak the same language here as in
Paldea, the culture is somehow different, isn’t it?\c
Perhaps your dear Salvatore’s education about
the world has been of help to you here?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp01_select_01
entries.text: For sure!

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp01_select_02
entries.text: I’m not sure...

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp01_03
entries.text: Oh! Merci so very, very much! I am so happy to\nhear you agree at once![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp01_03b
entries.text: Oh! Quel choc! This is quite disappointing, after\nall the hard work I put into making my classes so\r\nvery memorable and effective![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp01_04
entries.text:
But my work is not done! The students of
l’Académie Blueberrie would benefit from
memorable, effective lessons on language
and life as well![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp01_05
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I will do my best to educate them! Toi aussi—you
too,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]—do
all
the
good
you can![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_00
entries.text: I must once again say merci so very, very much\nto you for inviting me here, mon ami[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]e.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_01
entries.text: Jetting around from one region to another—yes,\nit brings back so many memories of my past![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_select_01
entries.text: Memories of your past?

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_select_02
entries.text: Where did you travel?

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_02
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Merci, [VAR 0x0100(0000)], for latching onto
my
tantalizing
hint
there!
I’m
so
glad
you asked![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_03
entries.text: Why, when I was a young man, I traveled across\nthe entire world! Dans le monde entier![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_04
entries.text: I went here and there and everywhere as a young\nbackpacker, beholding all the world’s beauty.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_05
entries.text: And here now, a question to you![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_06
entries.text: What do you think that I, a young Salvatore,\nfound le plus beau—the most beautiful of all—\r\namong the many sights that I saw?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_select_03
entries.text: The mountains!

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_select_04
entries.text: The oceans!

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_select_05
entries.text: The deserts!

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_select_06
entries.text: The towns!

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_07
entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Non non! That is not it at all! Was this question\nmore difficult than I thought,\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_08
entries.text: The most beautiful sight of all...was the face of a\ncertain woman, caught in stunning profile![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_09
entries.text: And that woman is now ma femme—my wife![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp02_10
entries.text: It’s a very good story, isn’t it? You’re welcome\nfor the gift of getting to hear it.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_00
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]My dear [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Are you as well
and
good
as
I
on
this
fine day?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_01
entries.text: All of the students at this school have such a\nfantastique passion for learning![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_02
entries.text: They are so eager to learn new words so they\nmay communicate with Trainers across the world![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_03
entries.text: You see what a difference it makes to have une\nbonne motivation—a good motivation trumps all![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_04
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]This reminds me, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
I’ve
been
wondering:
Do
you
have
a
particular
aspiration
for
the future?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_select_01
entries.text: I’ve got so many!

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_select_02
entries.text: Not so far...

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_05
entries.text: So many! Quelle chance! You’re most fortunate\nto have many dreams, and I cheer for them all![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_05b
entries.text: Oh, not yet? Going at your own pace is a fine\nthing too. Don’t force yourself to try to match\r\nothers. Oui, à ton rythme, c’est bien.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_06
entries.text: Indeed, I myself only stumbled into becoming a\nteacher after traveling the world and learning the\r\nlanguages of ten different lands along the way![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_sp03_07
entries.text: Life is full of many surprises. As is your teacher![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_trade_01_00
entries.text:
Everything in life comes down to l’essentiel—the
basics. And personal interactions are the most
basic of all, making the whole world spin round.\c
You must be flexible in your dealings with others.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_trade_01_01
entries.text: I think it would be good for you, mon ami[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]e, to\ninteract more with your dear teacher Salvatore![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_trade_01_02
entries.text: C’est-à-dire—that is to say—we should trade\nPokémon![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_trade_01_03
entries.text: Voilà, I offer you this delightful Meowth! How\nwill you then respond, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_trade_01_04
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Un [VAR 0x0101(0001)]! This is a
splendid
choice!\c
A very, very grand merci to you for trading
Pokémon with me, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Have we un accord? You agree to trade your
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
for

Meowth,

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_trade_02_01

Wait—attendez! I cannot possibly take your only
Pokémon away from you!\c
Please, you must come again when you have at
least two Pokémon available to you.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_trade_03_01

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_battleend_win_00_02

I have no doubt that next time you will show me

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_randomtalk_00
entries.text: Some of the students at our school started to\ncall me “Brovatore,” but this is new vocabulary\r\nfor me. Tell me, what is a Brova?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_language_randomtalk_01
entries.text: Whenever I’m away for a while, all the students\nde ma classe—in my class, of course—pitch in\r\nto take care of little Pawmi for me.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

When you are in a new place, all around you is

Yet take them one by one, and before you know
